label: Total declared income (reddito complessivo), tax year 2021
detail: From the 730/2022 tax return published under Italian transparency rules (Law 441/1982; Legislative Decree 33/2013, art. 14). Components: parliamentary allowance 98,471 EUR; author's income from the economic use of intellectual works 55,000 EUR gross (41,250 EUR after the 25% flat deduction); 19,000 EUR of occasional self-employment income; 1,985 EUR attributed to the main home. Taxable income 151,915 EUR; net tax 50,857 EUR.

label: Total declared income (reddito complessivo), tax year 2022
detail: From the Redditi PF 2023 return. Components: parliamentary allowance 98,471 EUR; author's royalties 257,434 EUR gross (193,075 EUR net of the 25% flat deduction); 1,985 EUR attributed to the main home. Taxable income 284,798 EUR; net tax 108,878 EUR. The returns do not name the works; press reports link the royalties to her books.

label: Total declared income (reddito complessivo), tax year 2023
detail: From the Redditi PF 2024 return. Components: parliamentary allowance 98,471 EUR; author's royalties 478,672 EUR gross (359,004 EUR net of the 25% flat deduction); 1,985 EUR attributed to the main home. Taxable income 451,196 EUR; net tax 180,983 EUR. Press coverage in October 2024 described it as 'almost half a million' euros.

label: Total declared income (reddito complessivo), tax year 2024
detail: From the Redditi PF 2025 return, signed 28 October 2025. Components: parliamentary allowance 98,471 EUR; author's royalties 35,260 EUR gross (26,445 EUR net); 55,000 EUR declared as compensation for 'obblighi di fare, non fare o permettere' (the form does not specify the source); 115 EUR attributed to the main home. Taxable income 178,371 EUR; net tax 63,066 EUR. Some press reports gave slightly different totals (e.g. 180,081 EUR); the figure here is the one on the official return.

label: Parliamentary allowance (indennità parlamentare), Chamber of Deputies
detail: The same taxable allowance from the Chamber of Deputies appears in each published return for tax years 2021 to 2024.

label: No remuneration as President of the Council of Ministers
detail: A declaration published on the Presidency of the Council's transparency page (dated 20 January 2023) states that she receives no compensation from the Presidency, under the rule against cumulating a ministerial salary with the parliamentary allowance (Decree-Law 54/2013, art. 3).

label: Declared contributions for the 25 September 2022 election campaign
amount: 9 contributions of between 1,000 and 20,000 EUR (total not legible in the published copy)
detail: Electoral declaration filed with the Chamber of Deputies (Law 441/1982 and Law 515/1993), with receipts from her electoral agent (mandatario elettorale) and contribution statements under Law 659/1981; the published copy does not state an overall spending total.
